title: Delivery AI agent
help: It tells each customer where their order is: received, confirmed, shipped, with the courier, at the desk, delivery failed, cancelled by the courier. First on WhatsApp; if the number has no WhatsApp, by SMS; otherwise the message waits in “To send” for the team. Customers’ answers arrive in Message AI agent, where Dellal knows the order.
off: Delivery AI agent is stopped: no message is sent to customers.

when.created: When an order comes in (website, page, form). The customer knows a call is coming and answers more often.
when.confirmed: When the team confirms the order: the product and the total, delivery included.
when.shipped: When the parcel leaves with the delivery company: delay and tracking number.
when.out_for_delivery: The day the courier has it (home delivery): keep the phone on.
when.stopdesk: When the parcel reaches the company’s desk (stop desk): come and collect it.
when.failed: When the courier could not deliver: the customer answers if they still want it.
when.returning: When the order is cancelled at the courier: last chance to save it.
when.delivered: After delivery: thanks, and an open door if anything is wrong.

cases.howHelp: Each status change sends at most one message: once per order for “received”, “confirmed”, “shipped”, “cancelled” and “delivered”, at most once a day for the others. A message waiting for the end of the night is replaced if the order moves on meanwhile.

cases.step2Hint: If the number has no WhatsApp, or the WhatsApp is not received within 1 h.
cases.step3Hint: No SMS sending set up: the message waits in “To send”, one tap to send it.
cases.nightHint: A night message leaves in the morning, unless the order changed meanwhile.
cases.title: The cases and their messages

cases.metaWaiting_other: {{count}} texts are not approved by WhatsApp yet: meanwhile they go by SMS.
cases.metaAllOk: All active texts are approved by WhatsApp.

cases.submitted_other: {{count}} texts sent to WhatsApp for approval

cases.example: Example with an imaginary order (Amina, PX2041). Each customer gets their own first name, order, total and delivery company.
cases.unicodeWarn: Arabic letters, emoji or ’: each SMS is 2 to 3 times shorter (more expensive)
cases.metaNote: A changed text must be approved again by WhatsApp (“Send the texts to WhatsApp”); meanwhile it goes by SMS.

tester.title: Test a message
tester.help: Pick a case, and an order reference to see its real values, then send it to your number. Nothing is saved on the order.
tester.demo: Preview: sending is simulated. A number ending in 3 or 7 has no WhatsApp and gets the SMS.

via.none: No sending possible (WhatsApp and SMS off)

tester.adminOnly: Only an administrator can send a test message (each one is billed).

results.title: Results
results.savedHelp: Orders told about a failed delivery or a cancellation, then delivered after all.
results.note: Customers’ WhatsApp answers arrive in Message AI agent, with the message before them. Dellal answers questions and hands over to the team to resend an order or change an address.

settings.enabledHint: Messages leave at each order status change.
settings.whatsappHint: From Message AI agent’s WhatsApp number. Otherwise everything goes by SMS.
settings.langHint: Darija in Latin letters reads like your chats and costs 2 to 3 times less by SMS.
settings.quietHint: A night message leaves at the end of this range (Algeria time). Same hour on both sides: any hour.
settings.waHelp: WhatsApp only allows a business’s first message with an approved text (“Utility” template). Pilotix sends your texts to WhatsApp for approval; it often takes minutes, sometimes 24 h.
settings.waConnect: Connect it in Message AI agent › Settings
settings.wabaHint: Meta Business › WhatsApp accounts, or in WhatsApp Manager. Used to send your texts for approval.
settings.waTemplates: Texts are approved in the “Cases” tab: “Send the texts to WhatsApp”, then “Check approval”.
settings.smsTitle: When the customer has no WhatsApp
settings.smsHelp: About 1 customer in 5 has no WhatsApp on their order’s number. They get the message by SMS.
settings.sms_gatewayHint: Automatic: from a shop phone (SMS Gateway for Android) or an SMS service.
settings.sms_manualHint: The message waits in “To send”: one tap opens WhatsApp or SMS with the text ready.
settings.sms_offHint: WhatsApp only: without WhatsApp, the customer is not told.
settings.android: SMS Gateway for Android (a shop phone)
settings.smsUrlAndroid: https://api.sms-gate.app for the cloud server, or the phone’s address on your network (http://192.168.x.x:8080).
settings.smsUrlHttp: Pilotix POSTs { to: '+213…', text: '…' }, with the token in an Authorization: Bearer header.
settings.secretKept: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
settings.androidHow: Setting up SMS Gateway for Android
androidSteps: Install “SMS Gateway for Android” on a phone with the shop’s SIM (an unlimited SMS plan is cheapest).
In the app, turn on “Cloud server”: it shows a username and a password.
Copy them here, save, then click “Connect SMS reports”: Pilotix will know whether the SMS was received, and customers’ answers will arrive here.
Keep the phone on, charging, with signal.
settings.hookHint: Received, failed, and customers’ SMS answers. Keep it secret.
settings.manualNote: Each message to send appears in Messages › To send, with “Open WhatsApp” and “Open SMS”: the text is already written, just press send.
settings.demo: Preview: sending is simulated, no SMS or WhatsApp leaves.
settings.appSecretMissing: Without the Meta app secret, Pilotix does not accept WhatsApp reports (read, received, not received): a message not received switches to SMS only after 1 h.
settings.appSecretLink: Add it in Message AI agent › Settings
